title: dlgradient
summary: Differentiate a traced scalar dlarray loss.
description: `dlgradient(loss, targets...)` backpropagates through the bounded automatic-differentiation tape installed by `dlfeval`.
behaviors: `dlgradient` must be called inside a `dlfeval` callback and `loss` must be a scalar traced `dlarray` value.
Host `dlarray` elementwise `plus`, `minus`, `times`, `rdivide`, matrix `mtimes`, and scalar `sum(...,'all')` participate in the tape.
Supported `dlnetwork` forward passes trace fully-connected, ReLU, ELU, and softmax layers and return gradients for matching `Learnables` trees.
Learnables structs, tables, cells, and `dlnetwork` objects preserve `Layer` and `Parameter` metadata while replacing `Value` entries with gradient `dlarray` values.

Implicit-expansion gradients are supported for scalar broadcasts; higher-rank broadcast-gradient reductions, custom layers, recurrent/stateful layers, and complex/autodiff over sparse data are unsupported.

examples.output: gradients matches the learnables tree shape.

example.input:
gradients = dlgradient(loss, targets...)
[g1,g2] = dlgradient(loss, target1, target2)
example.output: Gradient trees matching the requested targets.

gpu_residency: GPU-backed `dlarray` autodiff is rejected with an explicit provider-gap error. Plain GPU array math remains available outside the Deep Learning tape where the relevant builtin/provider hooks support it.
